title: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlighting the importance of always performing noble and positive actions
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam today, highlighting that no human being can ever remain without performing action even for a single moment, and therefore, one must always spend their life engaging in noble and positive actions. The Prime Minister wrote on X; "न हि कश्चित्क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत्। कार्यते ह्यवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः॥" No human being in this creation can ever remain without performing action, even for a single moment. Everyone is constantly driven to act, compelled by the inherent qualities of nature and their own disposition; therefore, we must always spend our lives performing noble and positive actions. न हि कश्चित्क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत्। 

कार्यते ह्यवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः॥ https://t.co/moHujtlBoi — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 16, 2026 ****** MJPS/SS/PRK
